info.title: Example Service API
info.description: REST API for the fictional Example Service: customers, their documents and orders, plus a few reference lists. Replace this paragraph with one or two sentences about your own API; it becomes the description of the generated OpenAPI document.

get.description:
Paginated list of customers. ?search= matches name or email, ?status=active|inactive filters by status

Customers are never hard-deleted: removing one sets is_deleted and hides it from every list. Email addresses are unique per account, compared case-insensitively.
